_comment: Device render profiles. page_mm = [width, height] of the writable page. stroke_pt = [min,max] for whole-pixel lines. toolbar_side/toolbar_mm = keep this side clear so the on-screen tool menu never covers content. ppi and px are the panel's; they are the calibration knobs. Folio devices (reMarkable, Kindle) override page_mm at runtime from list_targets when present; the others here are the ones Folio does not list yet, so these values ARE the source of truth for them. Tune ppi/px against a real device if a line looks off.

remarkable-paper-pro.label: reMarkable Paper Pro
remarkable-paper-pro.notes: Colour but muted; prefer black. Left tool rail is movable but default-left, so keep the left margin clear.

remarkable-2.label: reMarkable 2
remarkable-2.notes: Greyscale. Anything relying on colour must also read in black.

kindle-scribe.label: Kindle Scribe
kindle-scribe.notes: Greyscale, no persistent side rail in the reader. Delivered via the Kindle target (send-to-Kindle email) or Dropbox/Drive.

supernote-a5x.label: Supernote A5X / A5X2 Manta
supernote-a5x.notes: Not a Folio device type. Deliver via Dropbox or Google Drive (Supernote syncs from cloud) or hand the user the PDF. Manta (A5X2) panel is 1920x2560 @300ppi if you want to retune; A5X uses the values here. Floating tool bar sits right by default.

supernote-a6x2.label: Supernote A6X2 Nomad
supernote-a6x2.notes: 7.8-inch pocket size. Fewer modules fit; prefer a compact layout. Deliver via Dropbox/Drive.

kindle-paperwhite.label: Kindle (Paperwhite/basic)
kindle-paperwhite.notes: Small screen. Keep to 3-4 modules; it is a reader, not a writing tablet.
